description: This file implements minimal functionality to extract streams from an OLE2 Compound Document, including classes for directory nodes and the main document handler, with methods for reading streams and building directory trees.

classes.name: CompDoc
classes.description: Main handler for OLE2 compound documents, capable of reading streams, building directory trees, and handling sector allocation tables.

classes.name: DirNode
classes.description: Represents a directory node in the compound document, with attributes for directory entry details and methods for dumping info.

methods.name: CompDoc.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the compound document object, reads sector and directory info, builds sector allocation tables, and extracts streams.

methods.name: CompDoc._get_stream
methods.description: Retrieves a stream from the compound document given starting sector and size, handling sector chaining.

methods.name: CompDoc._dir_search
methods.description: Searches directory tree for a given path.

methods.name: CompDoc.get_named_stream
methods.description: Returns the named stream as a string if found.

methods.name: CompDoc.locate_named_stream
methods.description: Locates a named stream, returning contiguous data if possible, or assembled fragments.

methods.name: CompDoc._locate_stream
methods.description: Locates a stream's sectors, returning contiguous or fragmented data.

methods.name: DirNode.__init__
methods.description: Constructs a directory node from a directory entry, parsing attributes.

methods.name: DirNode.dump
methods.description: Prints directory node info for debugging.
